settings.missedFrameDefinition: V = 1000/60 ms. An rAF interval d > 1.5 V counts round(d / V) - 1 lost frames. missed % = lost frames / (lost frames + recorded rAF intervals) x 100, over the whole recording window.
settings.readyDefinition: navigationStart -> the rAF at which item nodes are in the box AND visible, and two consecutive rAFs have seen no DOM mutation in it

pan.input: the library's own: drag (mouse down, move, up) or wheel-x (horizontal wheel steps), as the page says

zoom.input: Control held + mouse wheel at the chart's centre, the page's |deltaY| per notch in and out: one 1.2x step where the library's rule allows it (Temporeum, vis-timeline, react-calendar-timeline), one mouse notch (100) for SVAR
